from decimal import localcontext, Context, ROUND_UP, Inexact, Rounded
from dataclasses import asdict
import importlib, math
from competition.deepeye.integration import motion
from competition.deepeye.simulation.authority.motion.kinematics import advance,RigidState
original_rom=dict(motion.CURVATURE_LIMIT_SQUARED)
expected=asdict(motion.validate('fast_9600',19,6000,0))
errors=[]
for context in (Context(prec=1,rounding=ROUND_UP),Context(prec=1,Emax=2,Emin=-2,traps=[Inexact,Rounded])):
    with localcontext(context):
        try:
            actual=motion.validate('fast_9600',19,6000,0)
            assert asdict(actual)==expected, (actual,expected)
            assert math.hypot(actual.curvature_yaw_per_m,actual.curvature_pitch_per_m)<=.5
            importlib.reload(motion)
            assert motion.CURVATURE_LIMIT_SQUARED==original_rom
            assert asdict(motion.validate('fast_9600',19,6000,0))==expected
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append(repr(error))
print({'failures':errors,'expected':repr(expected)})
assert not errors, errors
